abstract: We report the case of a 41-year-old woman with ovarian mixed germ cell tumor which was composed of polyembryoma and immature teratoma and who had high serum levels of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). By immunohistochemical methods, AFP was found in yolk sac cells of the embryoid bodies and immature hepatoid tissues, and hCG was found in giant syncytiotrophoblastic cells. She was treated with surgery followed by cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. She is well, and her serum levels of AFP and hCG have not been elevated for more than 4 years after the treatment.
abstract_ja: 本稿では、多胚腫と未熟奇形腫からなる卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍を呈した41歳女性の症例を報告する。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が高値であった。免疫組織化学的検討では、AFPは胚様体の卵黄嚢細胞および未熟な肝様組織に、hCGは巨大合胞体栄養膜細胞に認められた。患者は手術の後、シスプラチンを含む併用化学療法を受けた。現在も健在で、治療後4年以上にわたり血清AFPおよびhCGの上昇はみられていない。
